fixture_name: Express-collector corridor planning study — Canada TAC planning (Toronto context, PD-licensed portal)
subject: judge-baseline

justifications.substance: Transfer-lane decision load under simultaneous permission/signage changes on a 420,000 AADT corridor is a credible driver-workload mechanism producing erratic maneuvers and collision migration, substantive even if partly operational rather than pure geometric planning.
justifications.evidence_grounding: Recorded corridor facts (AADT 420,000, three interchanges revised concurrently) anchor the factual claims and the pivotal staging logic rests on the verbatim EV-CA-003 quote about avoiding collisions elsewhere along the route.
justifications.jurisdiction_correctness: Framed purely as kind=safety_concern with null normative_basis_note, correctly distinct from compliance questions, and the CRSAG objective quote is used as intended for safety impact beyond project limits; no framework semantics violated despite staging leaning toward later-stage detail.
justifications.recommendation_quality: Specific and viable: quarterly single-interchange rollout plus defined before/after speed-differential monitoring gives an actionable schedule and measurable verification rather than a generic or null suggestion.
justifications.vru_coverage: Not applicable since the express-collector mainline is controlled-access with no pedestrians or cyclists, and the finding explicitly acknowledges and scopes this exclusion as required.

justifications.substance: A recorded ministry-vs-municipal conflict over express-collector transfer continuity genuinely blocks confirmation of the planning audit boundary, with a concrete completeness risk that redistributed interchange movements fall outside the RSA scope.
justifications.evidence_grounding: Pivotal documentation-discipline claim is anchored in verbatim EV-CA-038 text on accept/conditional-accept/reject with documented reasons plus EV-CA-003 on consistent documentation, while the conflicting continuity facts are stated as recorded inputs with nothing invented.
justifications.jurisdiction_correctness: Correctly raised as a compliance/process question (kind=compliance_question) kept categorically separate from any asserted collision mechanism, with the Stage 1 equivalency (EV-CA-006) and §5.6.2 response semantics accurately represented.
justifications.recommendation_quality: Specific and actionable: identify both records and the responsible office, require documented resolution reasons under the §5.6.2 discipline, and record the resulting audit-boundary decision — all viable at planning stage.
justifications.vru_coverage: Not directly applicable on the controlled-access mainline, but the finding appropriately acknowledges that continuity outcomes propagate to downstream arterials carrying VRUs while declining to assert unverified exposure.
